body.name: \(L_n\) and \(U_n\)
body.construction: If \(\Theta^{\mathrm{cert}}_{n,\alpha}\neq\varnothing\), the decoded-law profile endpoints \(\inf_{Q\in\Theta^{\mathrm{cert}}_{n,\alpha}}\mu_Q(a)\) and \(\sup_{Q\in\Theta^{\mathrm{cert}}_{n,\alpha}}\mu_Q(a)\) are evaluated outward by \(\underline m^{\mathrm{cert}}_n(a)\) and \(\overline m^{\mathrm{cert}}_n(a)\), and set \(L_n(a)=\max\{-B_Y,\underline m^{\mathrm{cert}}_n(a)-\zeta_n\}\) and \(U_n(a)=\min\{B_Y,\overline m^{\mathrm{cert}}_n(a)+\zeta_n\}\); if \(\Theta^{\mathrm{cert}}_{n,\alpha}=\varnothing\), set \(L_n(a)=U_n(a)=0\) for every \(a\in I\).
